text:
mira: Quick heads-up: ops wants to run a config sweep to change `prefix_cache_ttl` from 30 -> 300 to reduce KV churn. Thinking about safe rollout and console visibility before we flip. Anyone see an immediate veto?

alex: Concern: 10x TTL will increase per-shard resident memory. Need an estimate of mem delta and effect on GC/evictions. Could impact small-model p99s.

jess: From Console POV can we annotate this as a sweep so the rollout UX treats it differently from normal feature flags? Prefer an optional `rollout_type` field in apply API (non-breaking).

tyler: We already have `purpose` on configs. Adding fields is ok but keep API minimal. Backwards compat is mandatory.

sam: Proposed rollout plan: 1) staging dry-run with replay 24-48h, 2) 1% tenant cohort (hash by tenant_id) for 2h, 3) 10% for 6h if metrics stable, 4) full sweep. Gates: >=5k sampled requests, <2% increase in quota_rejects, <5% per-shard mem increase, p99 latency delta <10ms.

ops-bot: Alert created: `prefix-cache-mem-80pct` -> Pager after 10m. ID ACL-3742.

alex: We need per-tenant cache size + delta in Console for triage. Console currently shows only global mem. Who owns building that panel?

jess: I can own Console work but need the API contract first. Suggest `rollout_type` enum: ["targeted","sweep","dry-run"] plus optional `previous_version` and `applied_by` audit fields. Clients can ignore extras.

mira: Also want a simple rollback mechanism. Last sweep was messy to revert because we couldn't identify exact apply across shards. Either a `rollback_token` in apply response or rely on `config_version` atomic bump and keep previous version cached for 10m for quick revert. Thoughts?

tyler: Prefer using `config_version` instead of adding tokens. Controller keeps previous version for short TTL; revert = set version back. Smaller API surface.

sam: Telemetry gating note: wait a warm window of 30m after cohort rollout to compute deltas to avoid transient noise. Also only evaluate after reaching min sample count (5k). I'll draft PromQL for the deltas.

alex: Example dry-run apply we can use in ops playbooks:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.internal/v1/configs/apply \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_API" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"config_key":"prefix_cache_ttl","value":300,"dry_run":true,"meta":{"rollout_type":"dry-run","operator":"mira"}}'
```

jess: Console will show dry-run entries in orange with hovertext "no traffic change - dry run". For sweeps we'll show a different badge and a link to the runbook.

mira: Action items: 1) sam to run staging replay and post mem numbers by EOD, 2) jess to open minimal API extension PR (opt-in fields only), 3) alex+tyler to prototype per-tenant mem panel (use aggregated samples if necessary), 4) ops to wire alert into the canary step.

ops-bot: Noted. Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/prefix-cache-sweep

sam: PromQL draft for eviction delta (baseline vs cohort): `increase(prefix_cache_evictions_total[5m]) / increase(prefix_cache_hits_total[5m])` with cohort label filtering. Will post exact queries after replay.

alex: If staging numbers look safe we can start 1% cohort tomorrow morning.

mira: Thanks all. Ping here if you hit blockers. :thumbsup:
